source_text: The procedure is often conducted en masse during the summer "circumcision season," with boys rounded up by peers, family, or community elders amid significant social pressure; uncircumcised males face stigma, including ridicule as "supot" (uncircumcised), which can coerce participation despite individual reluctance. [32]
